crossRefs.note: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

people.name: Nahor
people.line: Son of Serug; father of Terah, Abraham's father.

people.name: Serug
people.line: Son of Reu; father of Nahor, ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
translations.asv: and Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
